jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager:in (all genders) für Paid Ads, Creatives und KI
jobs.description:
Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.

MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.

Unser Wachstum hängt an zwei Seiten gleichzeitig. Wer etwas verschicken will, braucht jemanden, der es mitnimmt. Wer mitnehmen will, braucht Aufträge auf seiner Strecke. Ein Download ist dabei erst der Anfang. Entscheidend ist, ob am Ende ein Transport stattfindet und die Person wiederkommt.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du verantwortest Paid-Kanäle und denkst den ganzen Funnel mit, vom ersten Kontakt mit einer Ad bis zum abgeschlossenen Transport. Zum Start arbeitet dich unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager in alle unsere Tools und Workflows ein, die bei uns KI-first aufgebaut sind.

Du bist nicht die Person, die nur Kosten pro Install drückt. Du willst verstehen, warum Nutzer:innen kommen, wo sie abspringen und welcher Hebel wirklich wirkt. Und du nutzt KI jeden Tag, um schneller zu testen, auszuwerten und zu bauen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.11. in Vollzeit als Verstärkung für unser Growth-Team in Hamburg 🚀

Aufgaben

  • Paid-Kanäle verantworten

Du steuerst unsere Kampagnen auf Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads und TikTok. Planung, Setup, Budget, tägliche Optimierung. Du entscheidest mit, wo der nächste Euro am meisten bringt.

  • Den ganzen Funnel im Blick

Download, Registrierung, erstes Transportgesuch, Match, abgeschlossener Transport, Wiederkehr. Du optimierst auf die Schritte, die für uns wirklich zählen. Mit Tech sorgst du dafür, dass diese Events sauber gemessen und an die Plattformen zurückgespielt werden.

  • Zwei Seiten, eine Strategie

Wir brauchen Versender:innen und Fahrer:innen, am besten auf denselben Strecken. Du erkennst, wo eine Seite fehlt, und steuerst Kampagnen nach Stadt, Strecke und Kategorie gezielt dagegen.

  • Creative-Pipeline

Du baust eine Pipeline auf, die unsere Ads dauerhaft frisch hält. Briefings, Hooks, UGC, KI-Varianten, Abstimmung mit Design und Content. Du weißt, welches Creative warum funktioniert.

  • Testing-Programm

Du testest systematisch statt nach Bauchgefühl. Von der Hypothese über das Setup bis zur sauberen Auswertung. Learnings dokumentierst du so, dass das ganze Team sie nutzen kann.

  • KI und eigene Tools

Du arbeitest KI-first. Mit Claude Code baust du dir eigene Tools für Auswertung, Reporting, Automatisierung und Creative-Varianten. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

  • Performance sichtbar machen

Du lieferst ein klares wöchentliches Reporting für Team und Gründer:innen. Nicht nur, was passiert ist, sondern was wir jetzt tun sollten.

  • Trends und Plattform-Änderungen

Neue Formate, Algorithmus-Updates, Veränderungen bei Tracking und Attribution. Du hast sie auf dem Schirm, bevor sie uns treffen, und leitest ab, was das für unsere Kampagnen bedeutet.

  • Datenschnittstelle im Marketing

Du wirst Ansprechperson für Datenfragen aus CRM, SEO und Social Media und verbindest die Zahlen zu einem Bild.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing und dabei eigenständig Budget verantwortet. Idealerweise bei einer App, auf einem Marktplatz oder in einem schnell wachsenden Startup.

Meta Ads und Google Ads kennst du in der Tiefe. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur aufgesetzt, sondern Account-Strukturen gebaut, Budgets über mehrere Kanäle gesteuert und auf Events jenseits des Installs optimiert. Erfahrung mit Apple Search Ads, TikTok, Mobile-Attribution und Tracking-Setups ist ein klares Plus.

Was uns genauso wichtig ist wie Tool-Wissen:

  • Du denkst in Funnels, nicht in Downloads. Ein günstiger Install, aus dem nie ein Transport wird, ist für dich kein Erfolg.
  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert. Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sauber und sagst auch, wenn ein Test nichts gebracht hat.
  • Du nutzt KI täglich und hast Lust, dir mit Claude Code eigene Workflows zu bauen.
  • Du kennst die Trends im Paid-Bereich und bringst neue Ideen mit, bevor jemand danach fragt.
  • Du triffst Budgetentscheidungen selbst und kannst sie mit Zahlen begründen.
  • Du schreibst Ad Copy, die unsere Zielgruppe wirklich trifft.

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch.

Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Arbeite, wann und wo es für dich am besten passt
  • Hybrides Arbeiten & Remote: Flexibilität ist bei uns Programm
  • Offsites mit dem Team: Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr
  • Free MUVN Rides: Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren
  • Corporate Benefits: Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deine Antwort auf diese Frage:

Performance Marketing für einen Marktplatz wie MUVN funktioniert anders als für einen Onlineshop oder eine klassische App. Wir brauchen Menschen, die etwas verschicken, und Fahrer:innen, die es mitnehmen, am besten auf derselben Strecke. Was würdest du bei uns anders angehen? Und auf welche Kennzahl würdest du als Erstes schauen?

Es gibt keine richtige Antwort. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst.

Oder schick uns ein kurzes Video dazu. Macht uns ehrlich gesagt noch neugieriger als jedes Anschreiben.

So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit Katharina, dann eine Session mit Jule an einem echten Case aus unseren Kampagnen, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team.

Fragen? Direkt an Katharina.

Let's get it muvn. 🚀

Who is Seyond? 

 
Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.
  • Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.
  • Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.
  • Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.
  • Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.
  • Partner with SIMPL's European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.
  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.
  • Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.
  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.
  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

jobs.description:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis – digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst.

Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen – und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €.

Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserer KI: Du kontrollierst, was sie vorschlägt, übernimmst die Fälle, an die sie noch nicht herankommt, und entwickelst sie mit jedem Fall weiter.

Eine steuerfachliche Vorbildung brauchst du dafür nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Du bist die Kontrollinstanz zwischen Daten und Automatisierung

  • Unsere KI liest Belege aus, ordnet sie Bankumsätzen zu und schlägt die Verarbeitung vor. Du prüfst diese Vorschläge: Rechnungsangaben, Steuerausweis, Zeitraum, Zuordnung zum Mandanten.

  • Du bestätigst, korrigierst oder verwirfst.

  • Du erkennst, wo die Erkennung systematisch danebenliegt: bestimmte Belegtypen, Lieferanten, Fremdwährungen, Formate.

2. Du übernimmst, was die KI noch nicht kann

  • Unklare Zahlungspartner, widersprüchliche Zuordnungen, Sonderfälle ohne Vorlage – alles, was sich nicht automatisch auflöst, landet bei dir.

  • Du recherchierst den Sachverhalt und entscheidest ihn im Rahmen unserer Prüfkriterien; alles, was eine steuerliche Beurteilung erfordert, geht an einen Berufsträger.

Je besser die Automatisierung wird, desto anspruchsvoller werden die Fälle, die bei dir landen. Die Rolle wird dadurch nicht kleiner, sondern fachlicher.

3. Du klärst mit den Mandanten

  • Du forderst fehlende Belege an – schriftlich, konkret und mit Frist. Das läuft asynchron, also unabhängig davon, wann du arbeitest.

  • Du verfolgst offene Punkte bis zur Erledigung nach, damit die BWA bis zum 15. steht, und erklärst verständlich, warum ein Beleg nicht ausreicht.

4. Du machst die KI besser

  • Du meldest wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder: Was passiert, wie oft, was sollte stattdessen passieren. Deine Hinweise gehen direkt an Engineering und Design – mit Rückmeldung, was daraus geworden ist.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Analytisches Denken: Du erkennst Muster und Abweichungen in Daten, ziehst aus Einzelfällen die richtigen Schlüsse und kannst begründen, warum etwas nicht stimmt.

  • Verlässliche Qualität bei hoher Fallzahl: Du arbeitest gründlich, auch wenn die KI in den meisten Fällen richtig liegt – gerade dann fallen die Ausnahmen leicht durchs Raster.

  • Verbindlichkeit statt Dauererreichbarkeit: Was du zusagst, ist im vereinbarten Zeitraum erledigt. Wann du es erledigst, entscheidest du.

  • Interesse an KI und Automatisierung: Du willst verstehen, warum ein System etwas vorschlägt, und nicht nur, was es vorschlägt.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets und digitalen Tools; Lust, dich in neue Software einzuarbeiten.

  • Klare, freundliche schriftliche Kommunikation auf Deutsch (C1/C2) – der Mandantenkontakt läuft überwiegend schriftlich.

  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz und stabiles Internet für deine Arbeitsblöcke.

Nice-to-have

  • Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie ein Geschäftsvorfall von der Rechnung bis zur Zahlung läuft.

  • Erste Berührung mit Buchhaltung, Rechnungswesen, DATEV oder kaufmännischer Sachbearbeitung – auch wenn sie Jahre zurückliegt.

  • Erfahrung aus einem Umfeld mit hohem Datenvolumen (Operations, Backoffice, Support, Fulfillment, Payment).

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools: Prompts, Formeln, Filter, einfache Automatisierungen.

Was wir nicht erwarten: steuerfachliche Vorbildung, Kanzleierfahrung oder Programmierkenntnisse.

Was wir bieten

🕒 Freie Zeiteinteilung, wirklich. Keine Kernarbeitszeit.

🤍 Realistische Planung. Kind krank, Kita zu, Ferien: Wir puffern das ein, statt so zu tun, als gäbe es das nicht. Sag Bescheid, wir schichten um.

🚀 Deine Verbesserungsvorschläge werden gebaut – nicht abgeheftet. Unser Anspruch: Ein klar beschriebener, umsetzbarer Vorschlag ist innerhalb von acht Arbeitsstunden live.

🤖 Du arbeitest an der Grenze dessen, was Automatisierung in der Steuerberatung kann – Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen, Hardware wird gestellt.

📈 Aufstockung jederzeit möglich – auf Teilzeit oder Vollzeit, wenn deine Situation es zulässt. Der Weg zur Spezialist:in für digitale Belegprüfung steht dir offen.

🏡 Vollständig remote. Büro in München im Herzen der Stadt, wenn du willst – Pflicht ist es nicht.

🎓 Echte Einarbeitung. Strukturiertes Onboarding und eine feste Ansprechperson – auch bei kleinem Stundenumfang.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics (all genders)
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by! 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a savvy Senior Analyst, Data Operations & Analytics to join our Data Office in Berlin and serve as the ultimate bridge between data, product, and business teams across our Hospitality vertical. You'll turn complex business questions into clear insights, reusable data models, and reporting that help teams understand their customers and business, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. If you're ready to combine strong analytical judgment, product and business understanding, and technical expertise to elevate data standards, and make a lasting impact, this is the opportunity for you!

Lightspeed empowers the businesses at the heart of our communities, from standout retailers to unforgettable restaurants to renowned golf courses. We are a global team who fuel ambitions with technology and insight.

From online and in-person operations to multichannel sales, payments, inventory management and data-driven insights, Lightspeed helps businesses grow, deliver exceptional customer experiences and run smarter across all channels and locations.

Join our driven, diverse and inclusive team to find your people, accelerate your career and create tangible solutions that help local businesses thrive.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • Develop a deep understanding of Hospitality’s business processes, systems, customers, and underlying data architecture to provide meaningful analysis and support operational excellence within the Pod.

  • Develop exploratory and reusable data models leveraging diverse data sources, supporting business partners with insightful datasets, reporting, dashboards, and clear analytical recommendations.

  • Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous stakeholder questions into well-defined analytical requirements, approaches, and solutions that address the underlying business need.

  • Be the bridge between the Data Office and the broader Hospitality organization, turning complexity into clarity and ensuring clear communication of assumptions, findings, limitations, and implications.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and data flows, and use analysis to help Hospitality teams make more informed and effective decisions.

  • Monitor and improve data quality by investigating discrepancies at the source, documenting findings, communicating impact, and driving continuous improvement across the relevant teams.

  • Collaborate with the Data Office to establish analytical standards and best practices, improve documentation and definitions, and mentor junior team members.

And a little bit of....

  • Stay up to date with developments, innovations, and trends in data, including state-of-the-art machine learning models and large language models (LLMs).

  • Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

    Who you are:

  • 4+ years in an analytical role, with strong experience in data operations, business intelligence, reporting, or process optimization.

  • Strong experience translating business stakeholder challenges and needs into technical requirements, analytical approaches, and practical solutions.

  • Excellent SQL skills, with the ability to work across complex data structures and multiple data sources; willingness to learn new tools and data systems.

  • Experience developing data models, datasets, dashboards, and reporting that are accurate, reusable, and accessible to business partners.

  • Experience in Hospitality, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Sales, or another operational business environment will give you a head start.

  • Strong business acumen and a knack for bridging the gap between technical challenges, analytical findings, and business strategy.

  • Enjoy tackling complex problems through meticulous research, structured analysis, critical thinking, and creative but pragmatic solutions.

  • Meticulous with data accuracy and quality, with a keen eye for spotting anomalies, investigating root causes, and understanding the impact of data issues.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex problems, analytical results, and recommendations with clarity and impact.

  • A drive to deliver results, strong organizational skills, a self-starter mentality, and the ability to drive projects autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Familiarity with GCP, BigQuery, Dataform, Looker, GitHub, and Salesforce is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Segment, Heap type of tools

What’s in it for you:

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:

  • Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

  • Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services

  • ​​Health and wellness benefit

  • Volunteer day to be able to give back to society!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Berlin Mitte · Hybrid (up to 2 days/week remote) · €60,000–75,000 + VSOP equity


Help us decarbonize cement and concrete - not tomorrow, today

alcemy is on a mission to keep 100 million tons of CO₂ out of the atmosphere every year by 2030. Making concrete accounts for around 8% of global CO₂ emissions, and our machine-learning software runs inside cement and concrete plants 24/7 to cut it - without sacrificing quality or driving up costs. We're already live in a third of Germany's cement plants and 30+ ready-mix concrete plants.

The role

You'll own the systems that get plant data into alcemy.

That data comes from external partners, and it arrives messy. You'll build and own the APIs and services that take it in, make sense of it, and feed the machine-learning models behind our recommendations - designing those systems, deploying them, keeping them running, and diagnosing what went wrong when something upstream changes without warning.

It's a backend engineering role with a data problem at the centre of it, and it's refreshingly hands-on with customers: you'll dig into real-world data, explain what you find to non-technical people, and make getting data into alcemy dramatically easier.

What you need is solid production Python, the ability to run what you build, and comfort talking to the people on the other end of the pipe.

What you'll do

  • Own the data ingestion systems that bring messy plant data from external partners into something our ML can use
  • Build and improve our ingestion APIs, moving us from strict, structured data requirements toward flexible, AI-powered ingestion — so customers onboard with far less friction
  • Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot your systems in production, diagnosing and fixing issues when something upstream changes without warning
  • Track down data anomalies and explain your findings to customers in plain language
  • Build and maintain the APIs and PostgreSQL databases behind our products, and keep production running smoothly
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with external partners, customers, sales and customer success - translating between the technical and the non-technical
  • Collaborate with the product team on backend work

Requirements

You'll thrive here if... above all, you care about climate change and want your work to count.

Must-haves

  • You've deployed production-grade Python applications
  • You know how to deploy, monitor and troubleshoot production systems in a cloud environment
  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you collaborate well across roles
  • You're comfortable working directly with customers, sales and customer success - patient, plain-spoken, and at ease with non-technical enterprise teams
  • You pick up unfamiliar codebases quickly, and you're keen to contribute early
  • You're open to using AI tools to augment how you work

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to machine learning or data pipeline projects
  • Experience with FastAPI, Flask or Django
  • PostgreSQL or similar SQL databases
  • Experience designing or maintaining integrations with third-party or partner systems


Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you.


How we work

You won't be working alone - you'll build collaboratively alongside senior and junior engineers, owning features end to end: build, test, review, deploy.

Small team, direct customer exposure, fast startup pace - so async communication, clear prioritisation, transparency, and direct feedback are the norm, and how we work is something we shape together, and keep improving.

We use Claude Code responsibly: AI to move fast, engineers always in charge and accountable, no AI-slop merge requests.

We'll ask you to be flexible. We don't have fixed teams or fixed projects here. As the business shifts, we'll ask you to move to where the work matters most and pick up new problems. If you enjoy variety and switching between problems, you'll do well here.

Hybrid by design (Berlin Mitte office, up to 2 days remote, plus offsites and boat trips), with real room to grow along technical-expert or management tracks - and the chance to lead a product area within a couple of years.

Benefits

    • 25 days' vacation - plus an extra day for every 2 years here, and the days between Christmas and New Year off
    • €1,500/year and 3 days/quarter for your own development
    • The Mac of your choice
    • An office in the heart of Berlin Mitte


Our Tech Stack

    • Backend & data: Python throughout - FastAPI (auto-generated Swagger/OpenAPI), SQLAlchemy, pydantic, pytest, mypy; pandas, polars, numpy, sklearn; uv for dependencies
    • Infra: PostgreSQL, AWS on Kubernetes managed with Terraform, ArgoWorkflows for scheduled jobs, GitLab for code
    • Frontend: React & Next.js in TypeScript with TailwindCSS; Blueprint.js / Radix UI; TanStack Query or axios; Streamlit for internal tools


Our Hiring Process is fully remote

    1. Intro call with our Recruiter
    2. Meet our Hiring Manager
    3. A take-home task that mirrors the real work you'd be doing
    4. Technical interview (90 min) with two engineers, including 30 min of live coding
    5. Team-fit interview (45 min) with two future teammates


At alcemy, we're building a team as diverse as the industry we're transforming. We welcome applications from everyone and assess every candidate on merit alone - regardless of gender, age, ethnic or national origin, religion or worldview, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We especially encourage people who are underrepresented in tech to apply. If you need any adjustments to take part fully in our hiring process, just let us know and we'll make them.


Note: We don't currently offer visa sponsorship, so you'll need a valid EU work visa.

Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen.
 
Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
 
Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Associate Director Sustainability Sales (m/w/d) für unser Team an den Standorten Hamburg oder Frankfurt.


Deine Aufgaben

In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem: 

  • Du verantwortest die strategische Gewinnung und Entwicklung von Kunden für unsere Nachhaltigkeitslösungen innerhalb der Immobilienwirtschaft.

  • Du vertrittst Westbridge auf Messen, Konferenzen und Branchenveranstaltungen und positionierst uns als führenden Partner für Nachhaltigkeit in der Immobilienwirtschaft.
  • Du analysierst die strategischen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Sustainability-Expertinnen und -Experten individuelle Lösungsansätze.
  • Du steuerst komplexe Vertriebsprozesse vom Erstkontakt über die Präsentation und Angebotserstellung bis zur Verhandlung und zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, verantwortest Deine Sales Pipeline und leistest einen messbaren Beitrag zu unseren Wachstums- und Umsatzzielen.


Das bringst du mit

Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln. Dabei ist uns besonders wichtig:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – idealerweise mit Bezug zur Immobilienwirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft, Nachhaltigkeit oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • Mindestens sechs Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Immobilienwirtschaft, Nachhaltigkeitsberatung oder im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Beratungs- und Dienstleistungen.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse rund um die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien, beispielsweise in den Bereichen ESG, Dekarbonisierung, Energieeffizienz oder nachhaltiges Immobilienmanagement.
  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidungsträgern innerhalb der Immobilienwirtschaft sowie nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung.
  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations-, Verhandlungs- und Abschlussstärke sowie ein souveränes Auftreten auf Management- und Entscheider Ebene.
  • Eine selbstständige, unternehmerische und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


So arbeiten wir

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst dich aktiv einbringen. Gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen entwickelst du Lösungen für komplexe Fragestellungen und hast die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Dein nächster Schritt

That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.

  • Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.

Your role

To take real ownership of what you build and take own end-to-end feature responsibility, we are looking for a Software Engineer (f/m/x). 

As a Software Engineer (m/f/x)  you will work on meaningful customer-facing problems within one of our platform modules and collaborate closely with product, design, customer success, and other engineers.

At Tanso, engineers are responsible understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, shaping the solution, making technical trade-offs, shipping to production, and iterating based on what we learn. Key responsibilities

  • Self-driven problem solver with strong ownership and execution mindset.

  • Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. 
  • A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security.

Our team

We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.description:
About the role

Our Security team protects Swile's products, data and engineering platform. We work with a simple principle: when something is recurring, we automate it, and when a security requirement can become code, we write the code.

As a Security Engineer Intern, you will not shadow the team, you will be part of it. You will handle real alerts, run your own audits and own projects end to end, with a dedicated mentor in the team throughout your internship.

What you will do

Detection and response

  • Handle day to day security alerts: triage, investigate, qualify, escalate when needed.
  • Improve what we detect: reduce noise, close detection gaps, propose new signals.
  • Automate the recurring: when an alert or a manual check keeps coming back, script it away. This is where we expect you to leave a mark.

Security audits

  • Run targeted audits, from a few days to a few weeks, on applications, configurations or third party providers.
  • Turn findings into a prioritised remediation plan rather than a list of tickets.

Projects you will own

  • Ad hoc security projects across the engineering platform.
  • Security review and hardening of the tools and integrations we rely on (Dust, third party providers, internal integrations).

Fraud

  • Support fraud investigations: dig, follow the trail, understand how an abuse pattern works and how we could detect it earlier.

What we are looking for

This is an internship, so how you think matters more than what you already know.

  • You learn fast and you are genuinely curious about security.
  • You are a doer: you answer quickly, you close loops, you do not let things sit.
  • You are pragmatic: you calibrate your response to the actual level of urgency and risk, and you know that not everything is a P1.
  • You are open minded and comfortable asking questions across engineering teams.
  • You are comfortable working in English, written and spoken.
  • You have some scripting ability (Python or equivalent) and a basic understanding of web applications, APIs and cloud environments.

Nice to have that would make you stand out

  • Personal projects, CTFs, homelab, bug bounty or security writeups.
  • First exposure to a SIEM, to detection rules or to log analysis at scale.
  • Curiosity for fraud and abuse patterns in a financial product.

What this internship is not

  • Not a pure GRC, compliance or policy writing internship.
  • Not a pentest internship.
  • Not a role where you watch dashboards without changing them.

Practical details

  • Location: Paris preferred.
  • Duration and start date: 3-6 months internship, ASAP or from January 2027
  • Mentor: a Security Engineer from the team.

jobs.description:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

  • Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

  • Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

  • Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

  • Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.

This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions.

  • Experience: 3–10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus

  • Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT.

  • Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms.

  • Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required.

  • Language: Native or near-native written English.


Legal Status:

  • You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly.

  • Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and medical imaging, shaping how AI systems localise and measure findings on CT.

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.

You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.

As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.

Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

  • Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

  • Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

  • The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

  • Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

  • The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

  • The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

Who You Are

  • 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.

  • Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.

  • Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.

  • A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.

  • A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.

Why This Role

India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.

Taptap Values 

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

  • Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

jobs.description:
Tennis Technical Lead (Data), Tennis

Location: UK

You’ll spend the majority of the time either working remotely from home or from our London or Basingstoke office. You won’t be expected to travel often but may want or need to visit event(s) to get an in-person view of how Data generation and distribution is performing and works in our operational workflows. Approximate ratio 85% Office / Remote Work, 15% On Site / Travel.

Reporting to: Tennis Technical Manager

Tennis Technical Team member alongside Technical Manager, Technical Project Managers and Technical Leads

Why Hawk-Eye & Why Tennis?

Join us at Hawk-Eye and be part of an exhilarating journey through the world of sports events. Our operations teams play a crucial role in delivering high-quality experiences at major sporting events worldwide. These are the different areas that you can explore:

  • Technical: Testing, improving and stress testing our systems to enhance the performance of our delivery across the tours.

  • Creative: Working closely with TV directors and external broadcasters to provide statistics and storytelling of insights across tennis matches during live broadcasts.

  • Operations: Reviewing, improving and strategising how we improve the efficiency of delivery across the globe.

  • Projects: On-site management of our service delivery across the globe. Liaising with external stakeholders to organise our technical requirements to be ready and sites to be prepared for our arrival, and to deliver our services to the deadline of the events.

  • Broadcast Production: Rigging and directing live TV broadcasts across the Masters 1000s ATP tour.

 

» Who is the Tennis Technical Team?

The Tennis Technical Team oversees all technical aspects of the department, including the planning and delivery of our technology at events, testing and roll out of new software releases and new products, and advising on hardware specifications. They also directly impact the long term product roadmaps for tennis through reporting bugs, feature requests and new ideas through to the Product and Development teams.

As Data Lead you will fit in as part of the technical pillar within Tennis. At each event there is a Technical Guarantee whose role it is to oversee our full technical delivery including the delivery of our data - this includes the hardware and software set up of Hawk-Eye’s Tennis Data Platform on site. It is this data platform that you as Data Lead will oversee and manage from event to event, ensuring we are producing data that is not only accurate but also distributed in a timely fashion to all contracted clients, meeting all quality of service requirements and service level agreements.

As part of the technical team you will also be regularly interacting with the Product team in order to report detailed findings on the Tennis Data Platform and to continuously move the product forward, ensuring that it is as easy to use as possible. You will also liaise with the Commercial team and Clients to understand all delivery requirements, new services & products requiring data feeds, and advise on the contractual commitments of Hawk-Eye’s data delivery. Equally you will play a pivotal role in educating the operations team to ensure they are best set up for success at every event.

 

» What the job is all about

The role is all about managing the day to day data services that we deliver across all our Tennis events that take place around the globe. In 2021 we rolled out our Tennis Data Platform which manages and produces a whole host of data feeds that are then distributed at various latencies to clients and third parties, as well as used internally to drive products. The management of this live service is essential as well as the storage of the historical data for future use. Data capture and delivery is one of the key foundational services that we provide in the tennis market requiring technical expertise, high attention to detail and well organised individuals to manage it.

Alongside the day to day management of live delivery, the Data Lead will also be driving and testing improvements while working to bring new features to the Tennis Data Platform that improve various aspects of Hawk-Eye’s overall service delivery at tennis events around the World. Equally, the Data Lead will be responsible for onboarding new clients, and supporting the testing of new feeds and features with existing clients.

Our data performance is constantly being assessed by meeting necessary contract service levels. A big part of this role will be producing and assessing data delivery reports, to provide both clients and senior tennis stakeholders with an accurate picture of our data performance from event to event, pinpointing areas of improvement and then helping to implement changes both technically and operationally to address those identified problem areas.

As well as being hands on with the data delivery and assessment, the ideal candidate for this role will also be capable of working with a team of people across operations, product and development teams, as well as clients. There will also be an expectation that this person can manage and coordinate a wider group of people through excellent communication and people management skills, in order to ensure both our live and post event data delivery is fully up to date throughout the tennis calendar year.

There is an expectation for them to have line management capabilities but it is not a requirement of this role.

 

» Overview of Responsibilities

  • Managing the data delivery schedule throughout the tennis calendar

  • Day to day data configuration

  • Quality control

  • Report Generations (both internal and external)

  • Data Delivery Assessment

  • Operational Support

  • Regression testing new releases of software & testing new features

  • Keeping on top of data development deliverables & deadlines

  • Onboarding and facilitating testing with new clients

  • Reporting and Feeding back issues / improvements

  • Data Storage Management

  • Standardising/Aligning Old Data

  • Data Access

  • Managing and executing data reprocessing

  • Full roadmap of the Data Delivery Platform

 

» What we need from you

  • University Degree or equivalent;

  • Experience of working across a global business within a multicultural working environment;

  • Experience introducing and executing new processes across a team;

  • Excellent communication;

  • Attention to detail;

  • Proactive, organised, efficient with time, diligent, able to prioritise and be self-sufficient;

  • A good understanding of the global tennis events framework;

  • Willingness to learn about cloud-based architectures;

  • Ability to be flexible with working hours;

  • Have an interest in statistics;

  • Some knowledge of programming languages

  • Data Analytics Experience

Not necessary but advantageous:

  • Experience using data and analytics tools such as Datadog and Splunk

 

We are…

Brave: The Data Lead demonstrates courage by proactively facilitating collaboration between teams and stakeholders with diverse objectives, confidently navigating differences to achieve alignment and progress in problem-solving initiatives.

Owners: Taking full ownership of their role, the Data Lead ensures the successful implementation of creative and operational strategies, driving excellence in processes and operations to meet the department's goals effectively.

Inclusive: The Data Lead promotes an inclusive environment by actively fostering collaboration and open dialogue within the team, ensuring diverse perspectives are considered in communication, influence, and collaboration efforts to achieve shared objectives.

Location: Onsite EPL & EFL Stadiums. We are hiring across the South Coast to cover our partner Premier League and EFL stadiums in Bournemouth and Brighton. Ideal candidates will live within easy commuting distance of both locations.

Contract Type: Casual hourly contract – Setup Day & Match Day
Hourly Rate: £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour. Rates vary depending on role

Role Overview:

As a Football Tracking Technician, you will work on-site at football stadiums across your region, playing a vital role in the delivery of Hawk-Eye’s tracking and officiating technologies for Premier League, EFL, and UEFA fixtures.

You will be responsible for the setup, calibration, and optimisation of services including Goal Line Technology (GLT) and Electronic Performance & Tracking Systems (EPTS). This includes connecting and configuring PCs and hardware within stadium fibre-optic networks, optimising camera alignments, troubleshooting technical issues in real time, and coordinating closely with remote operations centres, on-site technical leads, and replay operators to ensure seamless match delivery.

Comprehensive technical training and ongoing support will be provided, giving you full exposure to industry-leading sports technology systems and live match operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in elite football environments, live broadcast technology, and high-performance sports operations at the highest level of the game.

This role is ideal for individuals looking to gain practical, hands-on experience in sports technology while maintaining a flexible routine. Because live matchday operations follow the football fixture calendar - predominantly concentrated on weekends with occasional midweek commitments for training and fixtures - we are seeking candidates with strong availability to cover these key operational windows.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Stadium Setup: Rigging Hawk-Eye technology at the stadium. Please note: This involves physically demanding work, including running heavy cables, rigging cameras, and working at height.

  • System Calibration: Conducting pre-match setup, hardware checks, and technical calibration of tracking systems in accordance with standard operational procedures.

  • Live Match Monitoring: Actively monitoring hardware and software performance during live matches to instantly troubleshoot, resolve, and report technical errors.

  • Stakeholder Management: Liaising professionally with stadium staff, match officials, and host broadcasters on-site, serving as a trusted brand ambassador for Hawk-Eye

Why Is This The Right Job For You?

We’re looking for individuals who are reliable, professional, and passionate about football. This position is perfect for you if you possess:

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

  • A passion for innovation

  • A willingness to learn

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and pressurised environment

  • Flexible schedule with primary weekend availability

  • An interest in the sport of Football

Skills and Requirements

Essential Criteria and Skills

  • Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of computer hardware, networking, and fibre-optic connectivity, with a quick aptitude for learning in-house technology and software.

  • Availability & Flexibility: : Strong schedule flexibility, with primary availability focused on weekends and occasional midweek evening matchdays/training sessions in alignment with the football calendar

  • Professionalism: High level of professionalism and a calm, solutions-focused attitude when working in highly visible, client-facing scenarios.

  • Mobility: A full UK driving license

  • Passion: Strong football knowledge and a genuine interest in the sport.

Desirable/Bonus Skills & Experience:

  • Broadcast and Live events experience

  • Video routing Knowledge

  • Experience with Audio Over IP devices

What Difficulties Might I Face?

Up to this point, while there may be many things that you find intriguing about this role, the difficulties you may face should not be ignored.

Working Hours: Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings, and we are expected to fulfil our roles right to the end.

High-Pressure Situations: Working in a live broadcast environment on a production that is distributed to millions worldwide will bring high levels of pressure

As You Progress:

You may also have the chance to:

  • Opportunities for full-time employment

  • Increase your skillset and be more involved within our team

  • Contribute to improvements in VAR workflows and cutting-edge tech development

We’ll support you every step of the way, but these are roles where focus, resilience, and professionalism are a must.

 

Team Culture

At Hawk-Eye, we pride ourselves on a collaborative, high-performance culture where trust, passion, and innovation thrive. We believe in fostering an environment where every team member is empowered to push boundaries and contribute to the future of sports technology. Our work is guided by three core values:

  • We are Brave: We challenge the status quo, embrace big ideas, and constantly seek new ways to innovate in the sports entertainment industry. We aren't afraid to take risks in pursuit of excellence.

  • We are Owners: We take personal accountability for our work, our decisions, and our collective success. We celebrate our wins together and treat every challenge as an opportunity to learn, grow, and improve.

  • We are Inclusive: We believe our diversity makes us stronger. We cultivate a welcoming environment where unique perspectives are valued, all while being united by our shared love for sports and technology.

Compensation: £13.00 – £18.20 per hour

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - AI and Internal Tooling
jobs.description:
About Gattaca

Gattaca is an engineering-driven crypto technology company based in London. We build and operate Titan, the largest block builder on Ethereum. We are venture backed and have been profitable for the past 3 years.

Blockchains have created something genuinely new: a trustless, shared layer for financial instruments. For that to work at scale, the network needs infrastructure that can support extremely high throughput and sophisticated trading, while keeping the underlying system decentralised. That's what we build. Ultra-performant infrastructure that keeps decentralised networks efficient.

The role

This role exists to increase the operating leverage of Gattaca’s engineering team.

You’ll sit within the Platform team and focus on the tools and systems around how we build software, operate production and access information internally. Some of that will be traditional developer tooling. Increasingly, a lot of it will involve finding useful ways to apply AI to workflows that previously required an engineer sitting in front of a terminal.

There is a surprising amount of leverage available here. Our systems generate terabytes of data and our engineers can inspect almost every part of what happens inside them, but getting to that information often still requires knowing which database to query, dashboard to open or machine to inspect. The same is true of engineering workflows: useful context is spread across code, production systems, internal messaging, incident notes and individual engineers.

We want to make all of that much easier to use.

The job is to work out where better tooling can remove meaningful friction, then build it properly. Sometimes that will mean a simple internal application. Sometimes it will mean using AI to review code, investigate production issues, query internal data or automate repetitive engineering work.

What you’d work on

Your day-to-day work will span these main areas:

AI-assisted engineering

We want to use AI where it actually improves how we build and operate software. Code review is an obvious example, but there is much more scope around debugging, investigation, repository workflows and repetitive engineering work.

A large part of this role will be working out where those systems are genuinely useful, choosing the right models and tools for the job, and building the infrastructure around them so they become part of normal engineering workflows rather than isolated experiments.

Company knowledge and data

Our systems generate terabytes of data, but getting useful information out of them still often requires knowing which database to query, dashboard to open or machine to inspect. You’ll help build a cleaner layer over that information so people across the company can answer questions without needing to understand where the underlying data happens to live.

The same applies to internal knowledge spread across code, documentation, internal messaging, incident notes and dashboards. We want that context to be easier to find and use, while still making it possible to get down to the raw source when needed.

Internal tooling

You’ll build the tools that remove friction from how people at Gattaca work. That might mean improving CI and deployment workflows, building better interfaces around existing systems, or replacing a manual process with something simple and reliable.

Operational automation

Production systems generate a constant stream of information through alerts, logs, crashes and traces. Today, investigating an issue often means manually piecing together context from several places.

We want to make that loop much tighter. If a builder panics overnight, an agent should eventually be able to gather the relevant logs, inspect the host and codebase, understand what happened and prepare a fix for an engineer to review. If an alert appears in our internal messaging we should be able to investigate it from there rather than starting again from scratch.

Safe execution

The more useful these tools become, the more access they need. An agent that can inspect production, read source code or prepare changes is useful precisely because it can interact with real systems.

You’ll help design the boundaries around that access: what tools can see, what they can change, when a human needs to approve something and how everything is audited. The aim is to make these systems powerful without making them opaque or difficult to control.

How we work

We believe the best work comes from small, focused teams with full ownership over their domain. Deciding what to build and how to build it.

We keep hierarchy as minimal as possible. Engineers own problems, not tasks. You'll have significant autonomy from day one. After a few months you'll be driving the full loop: identifying something worth improving, understanding the problem properly, building it, deploying it and seeing whether it actually made things better.

That matters particularly for this role because many of the most useful projects will not arrive as clearly defined tickets. The tools available are changing quickly, and a large part of the job is noticing where a new capability can remove work or make information easier to access.

We deliberately keep the engineering team small and hire very selectively. That gives this role unusual leverage: a good internal tool or workflow improvement can make a meaningful difference to the output of the whole team. You’ll work alongside engineers from Jane Street, Citadel Securities, Tower Research, Flow Traders, Meta, Google, as well as people from startups and less conventional backgrounds.

Specifics we’re looking for

  • High agency. A lot of the work will start as something vague. You should be comfortable finding these problems yourself, deciding what matters, and taking them from observation through to something people will actually use.

  • Strong software engineering. We have no preference on language. But you should be comfortable building complete systems and moving across backend services, data, infrastructure and simple user interfaces when the problem requires it.

  • Good product judgement. Internal tooling is only useful if it makes people's work noticeably easier. You should have a good instinct for where automation removes real friction, where a simple tool is enough, and where introducing another system would make things worse rather than better.

  • High drive. There is a lot to improve, and platform engineers can be huge levers on team output. We want someone who moves quickly, raises the standard around them, and keeps pushing important work forward without needing a queue of tickets.

Skills we value, but aren’t a requirement

  • Experience building AI agents, tool-using models, evaluation systems or model routing.

  • Experience working with large analytical datasets and making technical data accessible to less technical users.

  • Experience with infrastructure management (AWS or other bare metal providers), automation, CI/CD and observability.

  • Blockchain fundamentals, Ethereum infrastructure, the transaction supply chain, MEV.

No crypto background is required. Several of our strongest engineers came with zero blockchain experience - what transfers is depth and the ability to learn fast.

Logistics

London-based, in-person. The problems we work on are hard enough that the value of in-person collaboration is extremely high. We're very flexible when life requires it, you have agency over how you get the work done, but the default is being in the office with the team.

We sponsor UK work visas for candidates who need them.

Compensation

  • Top-of-market base salary.

  • Bonus tied to company and individual performance.

  • Equity on joining, with more earned through performance.

  • Private healthcare.

  • Third Space gym membership.
