jobs.title: Quality Complaint Specialist
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Complaint Specialist to support our UK Superintendent Pharmacist and Quality teams across two connected areas of our pharmacy operation: supporting the triage, submission to suppliers, trending and investigation of quality complaints received from patients/customers dispensed commercially licensed medicines sourced from pharmaceutical wholesalers/suppliers, and the quality complaint investigation process for our non-sterile compounding (unlicensed "specials") pharmacy. This role is central to ensuring that every product-quality complaint — whether tied to a licensed dispensed product or a compounded preparation — is captured, investigated, and closed out in a manner that satisfies MHRA expectations, the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (including the Article 10/Section 10 exemption framework for unlicensed specials), and our internal Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS). You will work closely with the Superintendent Pharmacist, Responsible Pharmacists, Quality Control Teams, compounding staff and Pharmaceutical wholesalers/suppliers to ensure patient safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement are at the centre of everything we do.

You Will:

  • Serve as the second point of intake for product-quality complaints relating to dispensed commercial medicines and non-sterile compounded (Article 10 "specials") preparations, logging each complaint accurately and promptly in the complaint management system.

  • Support the Superintendent Pharmacist in triaging incoming complaints to determine severity, patient safety impact, and whether escalation (e.g., potential recall, MHRA Yellow Card, or Defective Medicines Report Centre notification) is required.

  • Lead and/or support end-to-end complaint investigations, including root cause analysis, batch/lot traceability, retained sample review, where applicable, and liaison with the originating pharmaceutical supplier or wholesaler where the complaint concerns a commercially sourced product.

  • Support complaint investigations specific to non-sterile compounded preparations, ensuring alignment with MHRA guidance on unlicensed medicines ("specials"), Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (Article 10/Regulation 3, Schedule 1 exemptions), and applicable professional standards (GPhC, RPS non-sterile compounding guidance).

  • Draft clear, well-evidenced investigation reports and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) plans, when applicable; track CAPAs to timely closure and verify effectiveness.

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation in line with Good Documentation Practice (GDP), including complaint files, correspondence with patients/prescribers/suppliers, and trending data.

  • Identify and report trends in complaint data to the Superintendent Pharmacist and Quality leadership, flagging recurring issues that may indicate a systemic quality or supply issue.

  • Support the Superintendent Pharmacist in maintaining the pharmacy's compliance with MHRA inspection readiness, GPhC standards for registered pharmacies, and relevant SOPs governing complaint handling, deviations, and non-conformances.

  • Assist with drafting, reviewing, and revising SOPs related to complaint handling, non-conformance management, and supplier quality as it relates to complaint handling for both the dispensing and compounding operations.

  • Liaise with pharmaceutical suppliers and wholesalers to ensure appropriate records are available as necessary to close out applicable complaint investigations, when necessary.

  • Support internal audits and MHRA/GPhC inspections by preparing complaint files, trend reports, and CAPA evidence.

  • Escalate any signal of a potential quality defect, adverse reaction, or patient safety risk to the Superintendent Pharmacist without delay.

You Have:

  • 3+ years Experience in a pharmacy, pharmaceutical quality, or regulatory affairs role within the UK, ideally within a dispensing pharmacy, wholesaler, or compounding/"specials" manufacturing environment.

  • Working knowledge of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012, including the Article 10 exemption framework for unlicensed "specials," and familiarity with MHRA guidance on complaint handling, recalls, and Defective Medicines Reporting.

  • Understanding of GPhC standards for registered pharmacies and pharmacy professionals, and experience supporting a Superintendent Pharmacist or Responsible Pharmacist in a regulated environment.

  • Familiarity with non-sterile compounding practices and associated quality/regulatory expectations (e.g., RPS professional guidance on unlicensed specials).

  • Strong root cause analysis and CAPA experience; comfort applying structured investigation methodologies (e.g., 5 Whys, fishbone/Ishikawa).

  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, defensible investigation reports for regulators, auditors, and internal stakeholders.

  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple open investigations against defined timelines.

  • Experience with quality management systems (QMS) or complaint-tracking databases preferred.

jobs.title: Werkstudent:in - Social Media / Content Creation
jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun, sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Um unserer Community noch näher zu kommen, brauchen wir Dich!

Deine Mission: Als Werkstudent:in im Social Media Bereich schaffst du echten Content-Impact für die Marke vly. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Social Media Manager:in sowie dem E-Commerce & Marketing Team unterstützt du dabei sowohl im organischen Bereich als auch für unsere Performance Ads.

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Content Creation: Du entwickelst zusammen mit dem Social Media Team kreative Ideen, stehst vor der Kamera und nimmst eigenen Content auf (Fokus auf IG Reels & TikTok).
  • Editing & Post-Production: Du schneidest deine gedrehten Videos eigenständig mit CapCut.
  • Format- & Grafik-Erstellung: Du erstellst ergänzende visuelle Assets mit Canva und nutzt moderne KI-Tools, um deinen Workflow zu beschleunigen.
  • Trend-Scouting & Testing: Social Media ist deine Leidenschaft. Du verfolgst aktuelle Trends täglich und identifizierst aktiv virale Formate für unsere Social Media Präsenz und hast Spaß dabei, diese vor der Kamera direkt umzusetzen.
  • Content-Skalierung & Assets: In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Performance Team drehst und schneidest du Performance Ads und kreierst neue Hooks für unsere Zielgruppen.

Deine Benefits:

  • Werde Teil unserer Mission: Sei dabei, den Wandel von tierischen zu pflanzlichen Proteinen voranzutreiben!
  • Eine faszinierende Branche - Milchprodukte sind in fast jedem Haushalt zu finden, Haferm*lch und Blutzucker ist in den sozialen Netzwerken allgegenwärtig und die Bedeutung von Gesundheit nimmt ständig zu.
  • Echtes Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserem eigener vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket als auch zu deiner USC-Mitgliedschaft.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Berufserfahrung: Du hast erste, nachweisbare Erfahrung damit gesammelt, Social Media Content zu erstellen und hast einen eigenen Account.

  • Ausbildung: Du studierst im Bereich Marketing, Design, Kommunikations- & Medienwissenschaften oder äquivalenten Bereichen und bist noch für mindestens 1 Jahr eingeschrieben.
  • Shooting & Cutting Skills: Du weißt, wie man ein Smartphone für gute Aufnahmen nutzt (Licht, Framing) und beherrschst das schnelle Schneiden von Kurzvideos (z. B. CapCut).
  • Kamera-Präsenz & Personality: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, agierst natürlich und nahbar und hast Freude daran, unsere Marke mit deiner begeisternden Art persönlich zu verkörpern.
  • Gespür Social Media & Ästhetik: Du hast eine große Leidenschaft für Social Media (speziell für Instagram & TikTok), ein Gespür für digitale Trends sowie ein Auge für Ästhetik und Bildgestaltung.
  • Cultural Fit: Du brennst für eine gesundheitsorientierte Lebensmittelindustrie, fühlst dich in einer ambitionierten Scale-up-Kultur wohl, und lebst offene und proaktive Kommunikation.
  • Sprache: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Level.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du bist für 15-20 Stunden/Woche verfügbar.
  • Rahmenbedingungen: Deine Homebase ist Berlin oder die nähere Umgebung. Für den engen Austausch, gemeinsame Sparrings und die Team-Dynamik bist du mindestens 50 % deiner Arbeitszeit pro Woche bei uns im Office – die restliche Zeit arbeitest du flexibel.

Wenn du bis hierhin gelesen hast, sollten wir uns definitiv kennenlernen! Sende uns einfach deine Unterlagen - wir freuen uns schon sehr darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden.   • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

  • Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen.

Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen.

  • Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor.

  • Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit.


Your profile

  • Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin.

  • Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche.

  • Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst.

  • Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen.

  • Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.

  • Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland.

jobs.title: Fördermittelberater / Berater Forschungszulage (m/w/d) - 100 % remote
jobs.description:
Forschung im Mittelstand scheitert selten daran, dass die Ideen ausgehen. Sie endet dann, wenn das Budget ausgeht. Hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Sie setzen sich mit den Entwicklern an den Tisch, hören zu und arbeiten aus ihrer Arbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Sie kalkulieren es, formulieren es und bringen es durch die Prüfstelle. Das Mandat gehört Ihnen, die fachliche Entscheidung auch.

Genau dafür gibt es fundloop. Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung über die steuerliche Forschungszulage zu finanzieren, und haben dafür eine eigene Software gebaut, die Ihnen bei dieser Arbeit den Rücken freihält. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, ohne Beratungsapparat über sich und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

Sie beraten Unternehmen bei der inhaltlichen Ausgestaltung und Strukturierung ihrer Förderprojekte in Forschung, Entwicklung und Innovation. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Förderprojekte formen: Aus dem, was ein Unternehmen tatsächlich entwickelt, schneiden Sie ein sauber abgegrenztes Vorhaben zu - Technische Neuheit, wissenschaftliche und technische Unsicherheit und Arbeitspakete.
  • Fachlich bewerten: Sie beurteilen früh, ob ein Vorhaben förderfähig ist. Auch dann, wenn die Antwort Nein lautet.
  • Projektkosten selbstständig prüfen und kalkulieren: Personalaufwand, Auftragsforschung und Eigenleistungen, plausibel hergeleitet und GoBD-konform dokumentiert, mit Blick auf eine spätere Betriebsprüfung.
  • Mit der Prüfstelle kommunizieren: Sie führen den Austausch mit der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage in Stufe 1 und beantworten deren Rückfragen. Die steuerliche Einreichung in Stufe 2 verantwortet der Steuerberater des Mandanten, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten.
  • Mandate führen: Kickoff, Interviews mit Entwicklern und Technikern, Unterlagen einsammeln, Termine halten.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Naturwissenschaften, Technik oder Wirtschaft.
  • Forschungsbackground - Im Gespräch mit Technikern erkennen Sie, was wirklich neu ist und was gut gemachte Routine.
  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit Fördermittelanträgen, etwa Forschungszulage, ZIM, KMU-innovativ oder EU-Programme. Sie kennen den Unterschied zwischen einem schön geschriebenen Antrag und einem, der einer Prüfung standhält.
  • Sie sehen Chancen, gehen Herausforderungen aktiv an und arbeiten auf Lösungen hin, statt Probleme zu verwalten.
  • Selbstständige und verbindliche Arbeitsweise. Remote heißt bei uns Vertrauen, dafür strukturieren Sie Ihre Fälle eigenständig.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da Anträge, Projektbeschreibungen und Behördenkommunikation auf Deutsch entstehen. Englisch ist von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote - Vor Ort sehen wir uns nur gelegentlich, beim Mandanten oder bei uns in Düsseldorf.
  • Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden, unbefristet, Start ab sofort.
  • Eine Rolle zum Gestalten. Sie entscheiden mit, wie unsere Delivery aussieht, statt Prozesse zu erben, die jemand anders gebaut hat.
  • Werkzeuge, die Sie wirklich unterstützen. Unsere Software begleitet jeden Schritt eines Mandats, damit Ihre Zeit in die fachliche Beurteilung geht.
  • Kurze Wege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Beratungsapparat, keine Pyramide, keine Zwischenebenen.
  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind. Die Forschungszulage wächst, der Beratungsbedarf im Mittelstand wächst mit.

Wenn Sie Förderanträge nicht als Formularübung verstehen, sondern als Fachfrage, dann passen Sie zu uns.

So geht es weiter: Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Im ersten Gespräch lernen Sie die Geschäftsführung kennen, im zweiten sprechen wir über einen echten Fall aus der Praxis. Danach entscheiden wir zügig.

Wir sind gespannt darauf, von dir zu hören und freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Chief of staff/GTM to Raphaël Vullierme (Hexa Partner)
jobs.description:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.


The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF

WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco.

We’re building across three theses:

  1. Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need.
    This means we are building real technology with very fast time to market and value by moving atoms and not only bits.

  2. AI is the buyer.
    Buying decision are being taken by Agent or from an AI analysis. AI process more data and is less irrational / emotional than human. Cost to compare, switch, quote is trending to 0. This will have an enormous impact on market, what get sold or buy way beyond retail and ecommerce. This will much more transformative to the economy than the efficiency gains most AI startup currently focus on.

  3. Financial Services & Regulated business.
    Raphael was CEO of a full stack & regulated insurer. AI is eating the moat of large Financial institution and we are working to re-invent risk and capital is being moved and allocated.

We started in Jan 26 and so far WTF has had a very prolific year building 3 companies. The 2 first raised large seed 4 from TopTier VC 4month after the inception in 2 very different vertical.

  • WaniWani Agentic Commerce Infrastructure for financial services. Leading Banks, Insurers such as Chubb, Satender, BPI, Axa, Generali runs their AI distribution (selling insurance/mortgage to AI agent - on chatGPT/Gemini…) on Waniwani platform. Several million in ARR reach on Year 1 with US being fastest growing market.

  • Pelagon is building a foundational acoustic AI model for autonomous maritime protection, deployed across a distributed network of underwater and surface vectors to give European navies real-time understanding of underwater threats. Working with several EU navies and deployed commercially.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
jobs.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

jobs.description:
Ready to shape the future of B2B SaaS SEO while working with some of the fastest-growing companies in tech?

If you're equally passionate about driving strategic SEO initiatives and building strong senior client relationships, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for an SEO Strategist who can lead client conversations, turn SEO complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our Mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B SaaS companies unstoppable.

We're on a mission to be the best in the world at SaaS marketing — doing work we love, with people we like, how we want.

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

This is a client-facing strategic SEO role. You won’t just be auditing websites or creating recommendations in isolation. You’ll be expected to lead conversations, explain tradeoffs, guide clients toward decisions, and connect SEO work to business outcomes.

You'll have the freedom to:

  • Drive holistic SEO strategies that deliver measurable business impact
  • Build strong, strategic relationships with SaaS marketing leaders
  • Shape the future of SEO in an AI-first search landscape
  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking as much as technical expertise
  • Own client outcomes through clear strategy, communication, and follow-through

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

  • Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment
  • Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations
  • Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities
  • Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly
  • Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights
  • Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions
  • Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search
  • Embrace our core values:
    • Give a Sh!t
    • Always Be in It To Win It
    • Be Obsessed with Serving Others
    • Practice a Growth Mindset
    • When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

  • Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals
  • Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations
  • Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions
  • Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations
  • Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps
  • Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients
  • Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders
  • Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence
  • Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask
  • Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

  • Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization
  • Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance
  • Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels
  • Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights
  • Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies
  • Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS
  • Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution
  • Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients
  • Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention
  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement
  • Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates
  • Strong judgment in prioritizing SEO work based on business impact, client context, and implementation realities
  • Ability to present performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps clearly to senior stakeholders

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You prefer doing SEO execution without leading client conversations
  • You struggle to explain SEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations
  • You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, or guiding senior clients toward decisions
  • Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for live client-facing strategy conversations
  • You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and client follow-through

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking and innovation
  • Competitive base salary plus quarterly performance bonuses
  • 5 weeks of paid time off
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours — you just need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with North American time zones
  • Comprehensive health spending account and eye/dental/medical benefits for Canadian residents
  • Regular team meetups and annual retreats
  • Clear career progression path without requiring a management track
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to proven playbooks, frameworks, and professional development opportunities

What Future Co-Workers Say

Here are some comments from your future co-workers about their experience at Powered by Search:

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

  • Working with top 1% SaaS experts
  • Supportive and empathetic leadership
  • End-to-end control with no account manager involvement
  • Highly data-driven and results-oriented
  • Remote-first with a supportive global team and flexible work hours
  • Your growth here in 1 year is similar to 3 to 4 years in other companies

Your Growth Journey

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

You'll receive:

  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to our proven playbooks and frameworks
  • Regular professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Clear feedback on how to grow as a strategist, communicator, and client leader

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Account Manager will be instrumental in helping grow and retain Clipboard's existing markets. Healthcare providers are core to the Clipboard marketplace — the Account Manager is in charge of nurturing and expanding relationships with current users, going deep with those users to understand their needs, and ensuring they're consistently successful on the platform. There's no ceiling to what you can achieve in this role — if you're highly motivated to go above and beyond, a diligent executor, and a strong written/verbal communicator, Clipboard is the place for you to excel.

Responsibilities

  • Managing and growing relationships with an existing portfolio of healthcare providers and dental offices

  • Clearly articulating the value proposition of the app to current users to drive continued engagement and expansion

  • Going deep with healthcare providers and dental offices to uncover their evolving needs, understand their challenges, and find ways to genuinely help them succeed on the platform

  • Establishing credibility and rapport with providers, which includes demonstrating a strong understanding of the app

  • Being the go-to point of contact for users that need help navigating the app, resolving issues, and getting the most out of the platform

  • Helping fill new and urgent shifts in your assigned markets

Qualifications

  • Willingness to hustle / lack of fear

  • Experience texting, emailing, and talking with English-speaking clients and prospects

Requirements

  • Stable high-speed internet connection

  • A computer workstation (laptop or desktop)

  • Internationally located (not in US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)

  • Availability to work US working hours

  • Fluency in English speaking and writing

Beyond the Basics — What Will Make You Successful

  • Noticing & Curiosity — You pick up on things others miss and ask "why" more than once because the first answer is rarely the whole story. You dig to understand the root of a problem or situation rather than accepting things at face value, and you're constantly updating your understanding of the customers you serve.

  • Initiative & Persistence — You have a bias for action. You know that our customers are dealing with real problems today, and you don't wait for perfect information before making a move. You're scrappy and self-reliant, you find ways through obstacles rather than around them, and you bring solutions instead of asking "what should I do?"

  • Ownership — The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You take full responsibility for your results, fix problems when you see them — even outside your immediate area — and put processes in place to make sure those problems don't happen again.

  • Customer-Centric — You feel your customers' situations genuinely and care about improving their lives, not just hitting a number. Talking to customers and solving their problems isn't a task on your list — it's the job.

  • Humble — You're low ego and care about getting to the best outcome, not about being right. You readily admit when you don't know something, you actively seek out feedback, and you're always looking to become a better version of yourself.

Benefits

  • Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help

  • Competitive pay

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Fully Remote

Estimated annual compensation: $12,000–$15,600 USD. Each candidate's compensation offer within this range will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

  • Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
  • Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
  • Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
  • Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

  • 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
  • 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
  • ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
  • 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
  • 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide
  • 🧰 All the AI and tools you need to do your best work
  • 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
  • ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch
  • Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows
  • Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale
  • Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed
  • Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same
  • A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them
  • Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners
  • Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue
  • Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing
  • Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API
  • Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js
  • Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)
  • Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions
  • Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

  • Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.
  • Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.
  • Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.
  • AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

 

Qualification path

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

Senior Google Ads Account Managers should possess:

  1. Advanced knowledge of Google Ads and how to create and manage profitable campaigns for ecommerce and lead-generation businesses.

You will work directly with high-value clients as their primary point of contact and will be responsible for managing client relationships and creating and managing Google Ads campaigns for them.

At StubGroup, we have a milestone-based compensation structure that rewards our team members with increasing compensation as they generate more value for the company.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers hands for success. We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

  • Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
  • Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
  • Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
  • Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
  • Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success

 

A look into the day to day:

  • Building logic based questionnaires (asynchronous visits) through the Bask software (if you have experience with building logic based workflows, you’ll be great at this!)
  • Helping customers launch and upsell medications from start to to finish
  • Triaging bask software and order related questions and issues that come up for any of your accounts, any time of the day

 

We're Looking For

A self-starter who is passionate about enhancing the customer experience; you take pride in demonstrating the value of the products and services to your customers. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You are passionate and proficient in written and spoken communications.

 

Customer Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for Customer Success people who take full ownership of their accounts, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about the patient and provider experience.

What You'll Do

  • Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to draft communications, structure problems, and think through customer needs. Apply your own judgment to refine the output and make it human.
  • Validate with real customers and iterate: Test your approaches with real patients, providers, and partners. Use what you learn to improve how we serve them — before issues become patterns.
  • Make automation legible and trustworthy: Help customers understand what Bask's platform is doing on their behalf. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping their experience simple.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across the Customer Success team so we raise the bar together.

 

In this job, you will:

  • Build strong relationships with Bask’s customers and own the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, value realization, engagement strategies, expansion, and renewals
  • Partner with customer stakeholders to develop custom engagement initiatives that drive user adoption and support the unique needs of their patients
  • Manage all current customer data
  • Analyze customer engagement metrics and use them to communicate value, trends, and opportunities with key stakeholders
  • Deliver program demos, provide insightful technical answers, and recommend creative ways to get the most out of the Bask platform
  • Finding comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Believing no task is too small and no task is too tall
  • Work Weekends

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, or Customer Success at a SaaS organization
  • Experience in e-commerce
  • Experience with large- to enterprise-sized customer book of business
  • Creative problem solver with a determination to succeed
  • Independent and motivated, with the wisdom to seek help where needed
  • An entrepreneur
  • Highly articulate, ability to communicate effectively both when speaking and writing
  • Highly organized, with the ability to juggle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable collaborating with different teams (product, sales, marketing, etc.)

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - French (FR)
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

If hired we will ask you to submit a copy of your Independent Contractor Registration and/or Certificate of Vigilance. This documentation may be obtained from the URSSAF (Union de Recouvrement des Cotisations de Sécurité Sociale et d'Allocations Familiales) and also through https://www.guichet-entreprises.fr/.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in French & English.
  • Resident in France for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - German (DE)
jobs.description:
Verstärken Sie unser Team von Senior Ratern und leisten Sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Erstellung hochwertiger Validierungsdaten, die die Weiterentwicklung und Qualitätssicherung führender Suchmaschinen und KI-Technologien maßgeblich beeinflussen. 

Diese flexible Remote-Tätigkeit bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Ihre analytischen Fähigkeiten und Ihre Recherchekompetenz einzusetzen, um Suchergebnisse und KI-generierte Inhalte zu bewerten und gleichzeitig zur Entwicklung hochwertiger KI-Systeme beizutragen. 


Ihr Arbeitsalltag als Quality Assurance Rater

In dieser Position analysieren und bewerten Sie Suchergebnisse sowie KI-generierte Antworten. Mit Ihren Bewertungen und Ihrem Feedback tragen Sie dazu bei, die Leistung von KI-Modellen und die Qualität von Suchergebnissen kontinuierlich zu verbessern. 

Mit Ihrer Arbeit stellen Sie hohe Qualitätsstandards sicher und gewährleisten die Genauigkeit, auf die unsere Kunden vertrauen. Sie bearbeiten verschiedene Bewertungsaufgaben, analysieren Inhalte mit großer Sorgfalt, führen Recherchen zur fundierten Entscheidungsfindung durch und identifizieren Unklarheiten in Richtlinien sowie mögliche Inkonsistenzen in Aufgabenstellungen. 

Darüber hinaus nehmen Sie an Schulungs- und Kalibrierungssitzungen teil und bringen Ihr Feedback ein, um Bewertungsprozesse und Richtlinien kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und zu verbessern. 

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Bewertung von Suchergebnissen und KI-generierten Inhalten hinsichtlich Qualität, Relevanz, Genauigkeit und Nutzwert.

  • Durchführung von Online-Recherchen zur Überprüfung von Informationen und zur fundierten Entscheidungsfindung bei Bewertungen.

  • Konsequente Anwendung der Bewertungsrichtlinien unter Einhaltung hoher Qualitätsstandards.

  • Dokumentation von Sonderfällen, Lücken in den Richtlinien sowie aufgabenbezogenen Problemen.

  • Erstellung klarer schriftlicher Begründungen und Feedbacks zu Bewertungen, sofern erforderlich.

  • Teilnahme an Schulungen, Kalibrierungssitzungen und regelmäßigen Qualitätsüberprüfungen.

  • Erfüllung der Produktivitätsanforderungen bei gleichbleibend hoher Arbeitsqualität.

 

Vergütung

Die Vergütung für diese Position beträgt 20,60 EUR pro Stunde. Die Bezahlung erfolgt auf Basis der erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Aufgaben.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Unsere globale KI-Community ist ein lebendiges Netzwerk von über 1 Million Mitwirkenden aus unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen, die unsere Kunden dabei unterstützen, Inhalte zu erfassen, zu verbessern, zu trainieren, zu übersetzen und zu lokalisieren, um bessere KI-Modelle zu entwickeln. Werden Sie Teil unserer wachsenden Community und leisten Sie einen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Machine-Learning-Modelle einiger der weltweit größten Marken.

Qualifikationsprozess

Bewerber absolvieren projektspezifische Schulungen sowie Qualifikationsprüfungen, bevor sie in das Programm aufgenommen werden. Die laufende Tätigkeit unterliegt regelmäßigen Qualitätskontrollen und einer kontinuierlichen Leistungsüberwachung.

Grundvoraussetzungen

  • Tätigkeit als Freelancer mit sehr guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland in den letzten 5 aufeinanderfolgenden Jahren.

  • Vertrautheit mit aktuellen und historischen Themen aus Wirtschaft, Medien, Sport, Nachrichten, sozialen Medien und Kultur.

  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen, hohe Detailgenauigkeit sowie starke Recherchefähigkeiten.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Webbrowsern, Suchmaschinen und Online-Recherche-Tools.

  • Täglicher Zugang zu einer zuverlässigen Breitband-Internetverbindung, einem Smartphone und einem eigenen Computer.

  • Nachgewiesene Recherchekompetenz durch beruflichen Hintergrund oder eine starke Erfahrung in selbstständiger Recherche und Informationsverifikation.

  • Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und detaillierte Richtlinien konsequent einzuhalten.

  • Hohes Maß an Kreativität und logischem Denken sowie die Fähigkeit, konstant die Zielvorgaben zu erreichen.

 

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung, Content-Moderation, Datenannotation, Recherche, Journalismus, Redaktion oder Informationsverifikation.

  • Vertrautheit mit KI-Technologien, Suchmaschinen und digitalen Content-Ökosystemen.

  • Fachliche Expertise in Bereichen wie Popkultur, Sozialwissenschaften, MINT-Fächern, Medizin, Recht, Finanzen oder Ingenieurwesen.

  • Zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse können je nach Projektanforderungen von Vorteil sein. 

 

Gleichbehandlung und Chancengleichheit

Alle qualifizierten Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei der Prüfung für ein Vertragsverhältnis unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder dem Status als geschützter Veteran berücksichtigt. Bei TELUS Digital AI sind wir stolz darauf, Chancengleichheit zu bieten und setzen uns für den Aufbau einer vielfältigen und inklusiven Gemeinschaft ein. Alle Aspekte des Auswahlverfahrens basieren auf den Qualifikationen, Verdiensten, der Kompetenz und der Leistung der Bewerbenden und berücksichtigen keine Merkmale im Zusammenhang mit Vielfalt.

We specialize in teaching English to students aged 3 to 18 across Asia, using interactive courseware inspired by Oxford Thinkers and delivered through our self-developed online classrooms. Our unique approach ensures high-interaction, high-quality classes designed to enhance students' English proficiency.

Why Join Polly English?

Our flagship offering is one-on-one online teaching, enabling us to provide customized courses tailored to each student's needs.

  • Compensation: $16–$24 per hour.

Application Process

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

Once submitted, kindly notify us so we can expedite your application, considering your valuable teaching experience.

To welcome our new North American teachers, we're excited to offer exclusive New Teacher Rewards of up to USD $100 for teachers who join us and start teaching between August 14 and September 30.

🌟 Core Reward Rules

All rewards are subject to the following conditions:

  • Your first class must be completed by September 30.

  • No reward will be issued if the first class is not completed or is completed after the deadline.

  • No reward will be issued for class cancellations, no-shows/absences, or leaving the first class early.

💰 PPT Slot Rewards

  • Open 10 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete your first class.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $50

Option 2 — Earn $100

  • Open 20 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete at least 5 classes.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $100

⏳ Please complete your application within the next 2 days to meet the high demand for bookings.

Teacher Requirements

  • Native English speaker: USA, Canada.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.

  • Certificates: Teaching or teacher qualification certificate issued by local authorities, plus an ESL certificate.

  • Experience: Over 1 year of teaching experience in local or international schools (including overseas international school experience).

Technical Requirements

  • Software: Polly English APP.

  • Hardware: Stable internet connection and Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or above). Ensure your device passes our compatibility test.

Availability

  • Peak Hours (Singapore Time):

    • Weekdays: 5:00 PM–9:00 PM.

    • Weekends: All day.

  • Minimum Teaching Hours: 10 hours during peak times.

Given your extensive teaching background, we believe Polly English would be an excellent fit for your skills and expertise. We look forward to the possibility of you joining our team and making a meaningful impact together.

If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact us at teacherrecruitment@pollyenglish.com.

High Demand: Our marketing team is actively promoting classes, and newly onboarded teachers often receive bookings within 24 hours!
